info.name: Pay with saved card
info.description:
## Overview

Paymob facilitates seamless payments by allowing users to transact with saved card tokens, which enable transactions using previously stored cards.

**Payment Approaches**

There are **two approaches** for implementing saved token payments, depending on who initiates the transaction:

### 1\. CIT (Customer Initiated Transaction)

Customer-driven payments where the cardholder is present and actively participates in the checkout process. The customer only needs to enter their CVV to complete the payment with their saved card.

### 2\. MIT (Merchant Initiated Transaction)

Merchant-driven payments where transactions occur without direct customer involvement at the time of payment. The merchant processes the payment using the saved token via API.

## Prerequisites

**Before using either CIT or MIT, you must:**

1. Complete the **Create Card Token** process to obtain a customer's saved card token
    
2. Store this token securely in your database
    
3. Have the appropriate integration IDs configured in your Paymob dashboard

## 🔐 Authentication To authorize the Intention API endpoint, include your Secret Key in the Authorization header. ### 🔑 How to Get Your Secret Key 1. Log in to your [Paymob Dashboard](https://accept.paymob.com) 2. Enable **Test Mode** or **Live Mode** using the toggle at the top of the page 3. Navigate to **Settings → API Keys** 4. Click Copy next to Secret Key --- ## 📦 Request Body ### ✅ Required Parameters #### **`amount`** • Integer The total payment amount in **cents**. Must equal the sum of all item amounts. - Example: For 100 EGP, send `10000` (100.00 × 100) - Validation: Must match the sum of all `items[].amount` values ``` json { "amount": 10000 } ``` --- ###### `currency` • string • The currency code for this transaction. Must match the currency configured in your Integration IDs. - Egypt: `"EGP"` ``` json { "currency": "EGP" } ``` --- #### **`payment_methods`** • array List of **Integration IDs** that define which payment methods are available for this transaction. **What is an Integration ID?** A unique identifier for a specific payment configuration in your Paymob account. Each payment method (Cards, Wallets, etc.) can have multiple Integration IDs with different settings. ### How to Get Integration IDs: 1. Log in to Paymob Dashboard 2. Enable **Test Mode** for test IDs or **Live Mode** for live IDs using the toggle at the top of the page 3. Go to **Developers → Payment Integrations** 4. Copy the Integration ID(s) --- ** Usage:** If you pass a single Integration ID, the customer is redirected to checkout with only one payment method available. If you pass multiple Integration IDs, the customer is redirected to a unified checkout page where they can choose between the available payment methods. ``` json // Single payment method { "payment_methods": [12345] } ``` ``` json // Multiple payment methods (customer chooses at checkout) { "payment_methods": [12345, 67890, 54321] } ``` > ⚠️ **Critical:** Test Integration IDs only work with test secret keys. Live Integration IDs only work with live secret keys. --- #### **`billing_data`** • object • Customer billing information used for payment processing. **Required Fields:** - **`first_name`** (string) • Max 50 characters - **`last_name`** (string) • Max 50 characters - **`email`** (string) • Valid email format - **`phone_number`** (string) • International or domestic format **Optional Fields:** - `apartment`, `building`, `street`, `floor, city, state, country` (string) json ``` { "billing_data": { "first_name": "Ahmed", "last_name": "Hassan", "email": "ahmed.hassan@example.com", "phone_number": "+201234567890", "apartment": "6", "building": "15", "street": "Tahrir Street", "floor": "3", "city": "Cairo", "state": "Cairo", "country": "EGY" } } ``` --- 🔧Optional Parameters** **`items`** • array Array of items being purchased. If provided, `name` and `amount` become **required** for each item. **Item Properties:** - **`name`** (string, required if items added) • Max 50 characters • Item name - **`amount`** (number, required if items added) • Price in cents • Sum must equal total `amount` - **`description`** (string, optional) • Max 255 characters • Item description - **`quantity`** (number, optional) • Number of units - **`image`**: (string, optional) • url to item's image ``` json { "items": [ { "name": "Wireless Headphones", "amount": 5000, "description": "Bluetooth 5.0 Headphones", "quantity": 1 }, { "name": "Phone Case", "amount": 5000, "description": "Protective Silicon Case", "quantity": 2 } ] } ``` ⚠️ **Important:** Sum of all `items[].amount` must exactly equal the total `amount` parameter. --- #### **`extras`** • object Custom key-value pairs for merchant use. Returns in callbacks within `payment_key_claims.extra`. - Use for internal tracking, metadata, or business logic - Accepts any valid JSON object structure ``` json { "extras": { "internal_ref": "ORD_2024_001", "source": "mobile_app" } } ``` --- #### **`special_reference`** • string Unique identifier for this transaction. Returns as `merchant_order_id` in callbacks. - Useful for order tracking and reconciliation - Must be unique per transaction ``` json { "special_reference": "ORDER-2024-10-11-12345" } ``` --- #### **`expiration`** • number Time in seconds before the intention expires and payment link becomes invalid. - Type: Integer (seconds) - Example: `3600` = 1 hour - **Maximum and default value:** `3110400` seconds (36 days) ``` json { "expiration": 3600 } ``` --- **`notification_url`** • string This parameter overrides the Transaction Processed Callback URL configured in your Integration ID settings. ``` { "notification_url": "https://yourdomain.com/webhooks/payment-callback" } ``` #### **`redirection_url`** • string This parameter Overrides the Transaction Response Callback URL for this transaction. ``` { "redirection_url": "https://yourdomain.com/payment/thank-you" } ``` ⚠️ Please note that the notification_url & redirection_url functions properly only with the Card & wallet payment methods. Therefore, you can rely on the URL specified in the integration ID for this method. 📖 **Learn more:** [Transaction Callbacks Documentation](https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/manage-callback/transaction-callbacks) --- ## 📤 Response ### Success • 201 Created ``` json { "payment_keys": [ { "integration": 5083949, "key": "ZXlKaGJHY2lPaUpJVXpVxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", "gateway_type": "MIGS", "iframe_id": null, "order_id": 399862108, "redirection_url": "https://webhook.site/4b11a2fd-653d-467a-91a4-5820e6d4ba5c", "save_card": true } ], "redirection_url": "https://webhook.site/47822533-3652-46af-bfaf-20fe1f3469d9", "intention_order_id": 399862108, "id": "pi_test_68dbb55a027a4a7cb127449fd84144a3", "intention_detail": { "amount": 1000, "items": [ { "name": "Item name", "amount": 500, "description": "Item description", "quantity": 1, "image": null }, { "name": "Item name", "amount": 500, "description": "Item description", "quantity": 1, "image": null } ], "currency": "EGP", "billing_data": { "apartment": "dumy", "floor": "dumy", "first_name": "john", "last_name": "Doe", "street": "dumy", "building": "dumy", "phone_number": "+20102345678", "shipping_method": "", "city": "dumy", "country": "dumy", "state": "dumy", "email": "customer@example.com", "postal_code": "" } }, "client_secret": "egy_csk_test_6734a1fc392bc179dec8f4c2495842d6", "payment_methods": [ { "integration_id": 5083949, "alias": null, "name": "card", "method_type": "online", "currency": "EGP", "live": false, "use_cvc_with_moto": false } ], "special_reference": "phe4sjw11q-1122-22sas1aa", "extras": { "creation_extras": { "ee": 22, "merchant_order_id": "phe4sjw11q-1122-22sas1aa" }, "confirmation_extras": null }, "confirmed": false, "status": "intended", "created": "2025-10-12T01:33:27.138283", "card_detail": null, "card_tokens": [], "object": "paymentintention" } ``` ### Key Response Fields**Key Parameters to Note in Response:** - `client_secret` - Required for Step 2 to render the checkout UI - `intention_order_id` - Paymob's order ID, received in both transaction and card token callbacks for correlation - `intention_id` - The intention identifier, used to correlate the transaction and card token to the order/customer --- ### 🎯 Next Step: Open Checkout After a successful request, you need to redirect your customer to the unified checkout page. Refer to the **"Unified checkout redirection"** request in this collection to see how to construct the checkout URL using the `client_secret` from this response. --- 🆘 Troubleshooting | Error | message | Solution | | --- | --- | --- | | **401 Unauthorized** | Looks like the secret key is invalid / Authentication credentials were not provided | Verify Authorization header format: `Token sk_test_xxx` | | **406 Not Acceptable** | unmatched_item_prices | Ensure `amount` = sum of all `items[].amount` | | **400 Bad Request** | This field is required.
ex:
"amount": \[
"This field is required."
\] | Check the missing field provided in the responce message | | **404 Not Found** | Integration ID/Name does not exist in our system | Use test IDs with test keys and live IDs with live keys.
If the issue still persists, please contact
[support@paymob.com](https://mailto:support@paymob.com), as it may require additional configuration. | --- ## 📞 Support | Resource | Link | | --- | --- | | **Dashboard** | [https://accept.paymob.com/portal2/en/home](https://accept.paymob.com/portal2/en/home) | | **Documentation** | [https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/getting-started-egypt](https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/getting-started-egypt) | | **Support Email** | [support@paymob.com](https://mailto:support@paymob.com) |

## Open Unified Checkout After receiving a successful response from the Create Intention API, redirect your customer to the unified checkout page using the checkout URL. ### Checkout URL Format ``` GET https://accept.paymob.com/unifiedcheckout/?publicKey={{public_key}}&clientSecret={{client_secret}} ``` ### Required Parameters **`publicKey`** - Your Paymob public key (test or live) - Get this from your Paymob Dashboard **`clientSecret`** - The client secret returned from the Intention API response - This is included in the Create/Update Intention API response --- ### 🔑 Getting Your Public Key 1. Log in to your [Paymob Dashboard](https://accept.paymob.com) 2. Enable **Test Mode** or **Live Mode** using the toggle at the top of the page 3. Navigate to **Settings → Account Info** 4. Click Copy next to Public Key --- ### Example Checkout URL ``` https://accept.paymob.com/unifiedcheckout/?publicKey=egy_pk_test_abc123&clientSecret=pak_csk_test_xyz456 ``` ### How to Use Simply redirect your customer to this URL. They will see the Paymob unified checkout page where they can: 1. Enters their card details 2. **Checks the "Save Card" checkbox** (this can be pre-checked and hidden if requested) 3. Completes the payment --- ### Unified Checkout Interface The unified checkout provides a seamless payment experience with: - Secure payment processing - Mobile-responsive design - Automatic validation and error handling --- 🧪 Test Credentials ### 💳 Card Test Credentials | **Card Number** | 5123456789012346 | | --- | --- | | **Expiry Month** | 12 | | **Expiry Month** | 25 | | **CVV** | 1223 | | **Cardholder Name** | Test Account |

item.description:
## Overview

To enable saved token payments, you must first capture and save a customer's card token. This is accomplished by completing a successful 3DS transaction using the Intention API. The customer will have the option to save their card during checkout, and upon successful payment, you'll receive a card token via webhook.

## Implementation Steps

### Step 1: Create an Intention

Create a payment intention using the Intention API with a **3DS Card Integration ID**.

**Integration ID Types You Can Use:**

- Normal 3DS
    
- Verification
    
- Auth
    

### Step 2: Render Paymob UI

Direct the customer to complete payment using one of Paymob's UI options:

**Option A: Unified Checkout (Redirect)**  
Redirect the customer to Paymob's hosted checkout page:

Option B: Pixel Component (Embedded)  
Render Paymob's Pixel component for an embedded checkout experience within your website.

### Step 3: Customer Saves Card

During the checkout process, the customer:

1. Enters their card details
    
2. **Checks the "Save Card" checkbox** (this can be pre-checked and hidden if requested)
    
3. Completes the payment
    

**Important:** The card token will **only** be generated if the customer selects the "Save Card" option.

### Step 4: Receive the Card Token

After successful payment, you'll receive **two separate POST requests** to the `notification_url` specified in your intention request (or configured in your integration settings):

**First Callback - Transaction Details:**  
Standard transaction processed callback containing all payment information.

**Second Callback - Card Token:**

``` json
{
  "type": "TOKEN",
  "obj": {
    "id": 12929738,
    "token": "fb9fb86d94ff328efcdfed9b9eef7ac398cb446200c149b96a8ccd43",
    "masked_pan": "xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2346",
    "merchant_id": 1058607,
    "card_subtype": "MasterCard",
    "created_at": "2026-01-20T14:16:05.038717",
    "email": "customer@example.com",
    "order_id": "454732315",
    "user_added": false,
    "next_payment_intention": "pi_test_7ddb74640dd4495f9607034d3dcbedd6"
  }
}

 ```

**Security:** Verify the HMAC signature for the card token callback. Refer to the [HMAC Card Token Callback guide](https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/manage-callback/hmac/token-object-hmac-calculation-copy) for details.

### Step 5: Store the Token

Save the `token` value securely in your database, associated with the customer record. This token will be used for all future CIT or MIT transactions.

Create a payment intention following the same process detailed in [Create Card Token - Step 1](#step-1-create-an-intention), with **one key difference**:

##### Key Difference:

Include the `card_tokens` array in your intention request along with the standard parameters:

```
{
  "card_tokens": ["eafacchsnf1a3784444g4284b54319fath#12445488e1833633f7tab"]
}

 ```

**Important Response Parameter:**

- `client_secret` - Required for Step 2

## Open Unified Checkout After receiving a successful response from the Create Intention API, redirect your customer to the unified checkout page using the checkout URL. ### Checkout URL Format ``` GET https://accept.paymob.com/unifiedcheckout/?publicKey={{public_key}}&clientSecret={{client_secret}} ``` ### Required Parameters **`publicKey`** - Your Paymob public key (test or live) - Get this from your Paymob Dashboard **`clientSecret`** - The client secret returned from the Intention API response ### How to Use Simply redirect your customer to this URL. They will see the Paymob unified checkout page where they can: - Select the saved card (if multiple cards are available) - Enter the CVV number - Click to complete payment

item.description: Customer Initiated Transactions allow returning customers to complete payments quickly using their saved cards. The customer is present during the transaction and only needs to enter their CVV to authorize the payment. The full card details remain securely stored and are not re-entered. ## Prerequisites - A saved card token from the [Create Card Token](#create-card-token) process - The token stored in your database and associated with the customer ## Implementation Steps ### Step 1: Create an Intention with Card Token Create a payment intention using a **Card On File Integration ID**, including the saved card token. **Integration ID Types You Can Use:** - Normal 3DS - Auth - **Card On File** (Recommended for saved card payments) > **📝 Note:** In **Test Mode**, please use the **Test 3DS (Normal Card) Integration ID**. In **Live Mode**, the **Card-on-File Integration ID** will be created and provided accordingly. ## **Required Body Parameters:** Include the `card_tokens` array in your intention request along with standard parameters: ``` json "card_tokens": ["eafacchsnf1a3784444g4284b54319fath#12445488e1833633f7tab"], ``` **Key Parameter:** - `card_tokens` - Array of saved card tokens (accepts up to 3 tokens) **Important Response Parameter:** - `client_secret` - Required for Step 2 ### Step 2: Redirect to Unified Checkout Direct the customer to the Unified Checkout page: ``` https://accept.paymob.com/unifiedcheckout/?publicKey={{public_key}}&clientSecret={{client_secret}} ``` **Obtaining Your Keys:** - `public_key` - Available in your Paymob Dashboard ([Access Public Key guide](https://docs.paymob.com)) - `client_secret` - Returned in the intention response from Step 1 ### Step 3: Customer Completes Payment The customer will see their saved card on the checkout page and only needs to: 1. Select the saved card (if multiple cards are available) 2. Enter the CVV number 3. Click to complete payment Step 4: Receive Callbacks Upon successful payment, you'll receive transaction callbacks at your configured `notification_url`. **Security:** Verify HMAC signatures on all callbacks. Refer to the [Webhook/Callback HMAC documentation](https://developers.paymob.com/egypt/manage-callback/transaction-callbacks).

item.name: MIT (merchant initiated transaction)

request.description:
Create a payment intention using your **MOTO Integration ID**, following the same process detailed in [Create Card Token - Step 1 ](#step-1-create-an-intention) with **one key difference**:  
  
Key Difference:

Use your **MOTO Integration ID** in the `payment_methods` field:

``` json
{
  "payment_methods": [your_moto_integration_id]
}

 ```

**For complete intention request details**, refer to the [Create Card Token - Step 1](#step-1-create-an-intention) documentation.

**Important Response Parameter:**

- `payment_key` - Required for Step 2 to execute the MOTO payment request

Process the payment using the saved card token and payment key obtained from Step 1. This API call will charge the customer's saved card without requiring their presence or interaction.

**Prerequisites:**

- Saved card token from the [Create Card Token](#create-card-token) process
    
- `payment_key` from the intention response in Step 1
    

## **📦 Request Body**

**✅ Required Parameters**

`source` • **Object**

Contains the payment source information

- `source.identifier` • **String**  
    The saved card token received from the Create Card Token process
    
- `source.subtype` • **String**  
    Must be set to `"TOKEN"` to indicate payment with a saved card token
    

`payment_token` • **String**  
The payment key returned from the intention API response in Step 1

## ✅ Key Response Parameters

`success` • **Boolean**

Indicates if the payment was processed successfully

- `true` - Payment processed successfully
    
- `false` - Payment failed
    

`txn_response_code` • **String**

Transaction response code from the payment processor

- `"APPROVED"` - Transaction approved
    
- Other values indicate failure reasons
    

`data.message` • **String**

Human-readable transaction status message

- Example: `"Approved"`, `"Declined"`, `"Insufficient Funds"`
    

`amount_cents` • **Integer**

The transaction amount in cents

`source_data.pan` • **String**

Last 4 digits of the card number used

`source_data.sub_type` • **String**

Card brand (Visa, MasterCard, etc.)

### Step 3: Handle Response

Check the response to verify the transaction status:

**Success Indicators:**

- `success: true` - Payment processed successfully
    
- `txn_response_code: "APPROVED"` - Transaction approved by the payment processor
    
- `data.message: "Approved"` - Additional confirmation message

item.description:
## Overview

Merchant Initiated Transactions enable you to charge customers automatically without their direct involvement at the time of payment. This is ideal for subscription services, installment plans, and scheduled billing. The merchant triggers the payment via API using the saved card token.

## Prerequisites

- A saved card token from the [Create Card Token](#create-card-token) process
    
- **MOTO Integration ID** configured in your dashboard
    
- The token stored securely in your database
    

## Implementation Steps

### Step 1: Create an Intention

Create a payment intention using your **MOTO Integration ID**.

**Important Response Parameters:**

- `payment_key` - Required for Step 2
    
- Store this key for the next API call
    

### Step 2: Execute MOTO Payment

Process the payment using the saved card token and payment key.
